sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2014. Change Request Number 2014-031: retire [bmy] Bemba (Democratic Republic of Congo); submitted by Editor, Ethnologue (SIL International), 2014-07-25; adopted, effective 2015-01-12. 5 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Administrative document: p.2 sec.3c argues bmy 'is difficult to interpret.. as anything other than a duplication of the Bembe [bmb] entry' and that 'there is absolutely no sign of a different Bemba language of such a large population in Kivu province' (citing van Bulck 1952, Hulstaert 1950, Biebuyck 1973, Kadima 1983, Moeller 1936).

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2012. Change Request Number 2012-153: retire [bmy] Bemba (Kinyabemba) as equivalent to Buyu [byi]; submitted by Douglas W. Boone and Bagamba B. Araali (SIL Eastern Congo Group), 2012-08-28; rejected 2013-01-23. 5 pp.

sources.note: Nothing. Administrative document arguing 'Kinyabemba means the language of the Banyabemba, one of the peoples who speak the Buyu language' and that the stated population of 296,000 is implausible; no linguistic data.
